notes: Completed story set for Trial Phase Quality without duplicating prior IDs.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Scoring Contract
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S1.description: Define backend schema for trial phase quality including normalized phase enum (I, II, III, IV, UNKNOWN), numeric score mapping, and explanation metadata for downstream consumption.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S3.title: Implement Trial Phase Quality Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S3.description: Implement scoring logic mapping normalized trial phases to quality scores (e.g., Phase IV highest, Phase I lowest) with handling for mixed phases (I/II) and UNKNOWN values.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S4.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S4.description: Integrate trial phase quality score and explanation into EvaluateCare facade response so it is available alongside clinical trial results for UI rendering.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S5.title: Extract and Normalize Trial Phase from ClinicalTrials.gov Data
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S5.description: Implement extraction of trial phase from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize values into enum (I, II, III, IV, UNKNOWN), handling inconsistent formats (e.g., 'Phase 2', 'Phase I/II').

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S6.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Quality
EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1-S6.description: Create unit tests for phase normalization and scoring logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov response through facade output.
